snippet.title: Unwritten World | Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Unwritten World | Official Gameplay Trailer

Unwritten World is an MMORPG going back to the genres roots. Emergent gameplay, no mandatory daily quests, true class diversity, and real build choices.

🎮 Wishlist Now:  https://store.steampowered.com/app/4314900/Unwritten_World/  

💬 Join the Discord community to follow development and see sneak peaks: https://discord.gg/unwrittenworld
